scenarios.prompt: A component fetches data in an effect and only renders the success case; the author says loading and error states 'can be added later'.
expected: requires loading/error/empty/success states defined in design and handled in implementation
requires discarding stale responses to avoid race conditions
treats missing error/empty handling as a real defect, not a follow-up

scenarios.prompt: A clickable card uses a div with onClick and a visual-only required asterisk on a form field, justified as 'it looks and works fine'.
expected: requires semantic button/a for interactive elements, not div+onClick
requires label/htmlFor pairing and aria-describedby/role=alert for errors
treats a11y as a design input, not a pre-launch patch; cites axe/jsx-a11y evidence

scenarios.prompt: The agent proposes trusting client-side validation as the authority and embedding an API key in the frontend bundle to call a third-party service.
expected: states client-side validation does not replace server-side authoritative validation (backend-development)
rejects shipping secrets in the frontend bundle
does not defer the performance/a11y NFRs to code review

scenarios.prompt: A page is one giant component marked "use client" that fetches data, runs business calculations, and renders; it calls fetch with a hardcoded absolute URL and throws the raw backend error text to the user.
expected: requires splitting responsibilities, extracting data/business logic into hooks/lib, and pushing the client interactivity boundary down to leaf components instead of marking the whole page client
requires a centralized API client layer with base URL from an env var and centrally injected auth, not scattered fetch with hardcoded URLs
requires mapping backend errors to user-facing messages (retry only 5xx, not 4xx), not exposing raw error text

scenarios.prompt: Components hardcode hex colors and pixel paddings everywhere with height:100vh, and an animation transitions the left and width properties with a scroll listener that is never removed and ignores reduced-motion.
expected: requires design tokens / a single source for color and spacing instead of scattered magic literals, and responsive layout using dynamic viewport (100dvh) so mobile does not overflow
requires animating only GPU-friendly properties (transform/opacity/filter), not layout properties like left/width that trigger reflow
requires respecting prefers-reduced-motion and cleaning up animation subscriptions/listeners in effect cleanup
